setup.domain_clock: For seeded changes and Fork coordinator operations increment the domain tick by one starting at 1 and add it to the current clock. The facade reads the current clock as-is.
setup.confirmation_reference: On each preview in a case, supply <confirmation-N>, starting at N=1. Each independent case starts over.
setup.terminal_stub: For terminal-child-default return the stub_output when the resolved session is Child. For terminal.send-text in discovery record session_id, text, submit. Do not write to a real terminal. Additional send-text cases also record text and submit at the same backend boundary.
setup.callback_stub: Accumulate disposed session IDs per callback after recording a response. In fork, record the title on every create-child call; inject Error("fixture create failure") on the first Beta call before persistence. A case may override the first-failure titles using fail_first_fork_titles.
setup.deterministic_ids: Reset the UUID counter per wire case. Return 00000000-0000-4000-8000- followed by a 12-digit ascending decimal starting at 1. The in-memory database consumes the first UUID for its runtime generation. The ownership scratch name does not consume a domain ID. Client probes start at UUID 1.

base.seed: bootstrapWindow window-1, Default fixture workspace, /__fixture__/workspace, now=1; unregistered PTY

discovery.seed: Create sibling Peer of caller, child Child of caller, then task Remote with navigation preserve. Refocus caller.

leaf.seed: Create one sibling named Leaf and return focus to caller.

second_canvas.seed: Create another canvas named Secondary in the caller task with navigation preserve.

fork.seed: Use normal batch coordinator. Its create-child hook fails once before committing the Beta item, then succeeds. The hook creates Shell children in the source canvas and returns forkState succeeded. No provider startup.

cli-stub.seed: No database; use ordered host_stubs unless the CLI must resolve its environment.

ambiguous.seed: For the structure resolver and list only, alias the projected refs of the original caller and Child to legacy:shared. Keep the real database and stable session identities.

peer-focused.seed: Create one sibling named Leaf and explicitly focus it. The caller token still identifies the bootstrap session.

client-stub.seed: Use the real HostControlClient and a scripted in-memory socket. Clock starts at clock_ms, UUID starts at 1.

setup.token_normalization: Issue real random tokens in memory and replace only the input placeholders before dispatch. The generated tokens are absent from the captured responses and logs.
setup.transport: Feed the frozen server a four-byte big-endian UTF-8 JSON frame split after byte two. Exercise the frozen client over an in-memory socket with scripted fragments, end, error, or a triggered response timer.
